author: Mitomon
body:
Map Name: Mitopia-AW
Creator:Mitomon
Gamemode: DTM
*NEW* Download Link: https://www.dropbox.com/s/bag2nqqrt72b38a/Mitopia-AW.zip?dl=0
.YML:https://www.dropbox.com/s/6nc5t08rzj9fonv/Mitopia-AWyml.zip?dl=0

I incorporated a lot of redstone and other things in this map. It has one monument that is above each team's spawn. It's size adds some difficulty to both sides. There are abundant resources(pics below) that can be used to take the monument in efficient and creative ways. Please give me any suggestions. Thank you!
EDIT: Spawn now has a tnt cannon tutorial. TNT cannons have been added. Center wall has been added. Chests in the center with mystery content have been added.
Album Link:
http://imgur.com/a/dzEea#0
Album for updated version:
http://imgur.com/a/yD2KN#0

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
The concept is interesting yet it doesn't seem to be built properly or put at its best level.
The pathways are too narrow, thin and empty, the map is very basic and it doesn't really look appealing at all. Gameplay would be rather chaotic given the size of the map and it seems that the map doesn't have bedrock below it?
Size and shape of the map aren't good enough and I don't really consider this to be up to standards.
Sorry but from my part, I deem this map denied.
Perhaps improving it would be a good idea, you have an excellent concept, put a bit more effort and keep trying bud, best of luck.

Creativity: 3.5/5
Gameplay: 2/5
Aesthetics: 1/5
